rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial noun for an extra benefit, rather than a cash payment or points.

example.english: This deal comes with an extra bonus.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 jau1 wai6 zung6 jau5 zoek3 sou3

rows.note: Use this for an employee's extra payment or year-end work bonus.

example.english: The company paid a three-month bonus this year.
example.traditional: 公司今年派咗三個月花紅。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 gam1 nin4 paai3 zo2 saam1 go3 jyut6 faa1 hung4

rows.note: Use this for a bonus or profit distribution paid to a shareholder, rather than an employee's usual bonus.

example.english: Shareholders received a bonus from the profits this year.
example.traditional: 股東今年收到一筆紅利。
example.jyutping: gu2 dung1 gam1 nin4 sau1 dou2 jat1 bat1 hung4 lei6

rows.note: Use this specifically for bonus points added to a player's score.

example.english: Finishing this level earns you bonus points.
example.traditional: 完成呢關仲有額外分數。
example.jyutping: jyun4 sing4 ni1 gwaan1 zung6 jau5 ngaak6 ngoi6 fan1 sou3
